project.title: Corrections to geometric stability and observable inference in dual Koopman embeddings
project.summary: Exact source-specific counterexamples and repairs for arXiv:2609.28999v2.
project.research_question: Which geometric and phase-inference statements fail as printed, and which explicit definitions and estimation assumptions repair them?

claims.text: The geometric definition in source Eq30 retains initial separation. For the stated own-axis-independent directional maps, each raw separation is at least the packet width, so Eq31 normalized ratio is at least one.
claims.evidence_summary: Exact directional-flow proof and nonlinear Hamiltonian-shear check in experiments/verify.py.
claims.confidence_note: A correction to the printed criterion; not a universal failure of Koopman embeddings or a validated replacement threshold.

claims.text: The reference-phase fringe encodes a circular statistic. Positive variance can reduce contrast without shifting its maximizing phase, and two explicit positive grid distributions can have identical entire fringes but different arithmetic means.
claims.evidence_summary: Exact characteristic-function identity, symmetric-packet proof, four-node construction and finite-grid Hadamard checks.
claims.confidence_note: Targets the specific contrast-to-phase inference; genuine nonlinear cloud-to-trajectory bias and standard amplitude estimation remain distinct.

claims.text: The stated Lotka-Volterra field has paired gradient and Hessian norms giving H=L, so the source definitions yield R/sigma=1/sqrt(2) in dimension two rather than gamma/beta.
claims.evidence_summary: Analytic paired-norm calculation and deterministic calibration check.
claims.confidence_note: Corrects criterion calibration; both parameter values are small for the chosen benchmark, so qualitative benchmark failure is not asserted.
